flows.name: Explore Senda before signing in
flows.goal: A visitor sees how a diagram step connects to an interview passage and can try a full example.

steps.action: Scrolls to the live diagram and selects Coordinate readiness

branches.action: Clicks Explore the example
Clicks Pricing to compare Free and Pro
Clicks Privacy in the footer
Clicks Your processes to go from the local review library to hosted projects
Clicks Get a sign-in link instead of resetting a password

flows.name: Sign in and import a first interview
flows.goal: A first-time reviewer gets an evidence-backed As-is draft from an interview.

steps.action: Clicks Sign in
Enters an email address and clicks Send sign-in link
Opens the link in the email
Clicks Continue to Senda
Clicks New project
Uploads a transcript and fills in the optional process details
Clicks Create project
Asks the agent to draft the process, then refreshes the project after it saves

branches.action: Chooses a damaged Word file
Chooses a readable transcript instead and adds the process details
Clicks Continue to Senda using a link that has already been used
Requests a new sign-in link

flows.name: Connect a modeling agent
flows.goal: A reviewer gives an external agent permission to create projects or chooses the built-in chat instead.

steps.action: Clicks Set up your agent
Adds Senda in Claude and chooses to sign in

branches.action: Switches to the ChatGPT tab
Adds Senda in ChatGPT and chooses OAuth sign-in
Allows New projects, then asks the connected agent to map an interview and opens the saved draft in Senda
Clicks Senda’s built-in chat instead of configuring a connector
Opens built-in chat on an account without provider access

flows.name: Review and clarify the current process
flows.goal: A reviewer answers an interview gap, sees the revised diagram, and traces a step to its source.

steps.action: Opens Clarifications
Clicks Answer question and writes the clarification
Clicks Save answer on an account with a display name
Asks the agent to revise the diagram and reopens the project after it saves
Waits for the revised Clarifications tab to load
Returns to Diagram
Clicks Find a step or message and searches for deposit invoice
Chooses Issue deposit invoice
Clicks Show evidence
Clicks the cited source under a passage

branches.action: Clicks Save answer with a new email-link account that has no display name
Searches for a step or message that is not in the diagram
Changes the search to deposit invoice
Opens Walkthrough to read the process in order
Opens Review checks to see what still needs confirmation
Opens Sources to see the interview and clarification records
Clicks Return to diagram

flows.name: Plan a future process and export it
flows.goal: A reviewer makes a separate To-be draft, checks its starting point, and downloads the revised diagram.

steps.action: Switches to the To-be tab before making a future model
Clicks Create To-be model and describes what should change
Clicks Create planning draft
Asks the agent to revise the plan, then opens the revised Finance subprocess
Clicks Download this view to choose between BPMN and SVG

branches.action: Clicks Planning details to check where the future diagram started
Clicks View original As-is
Later opens an agent’s link to download the saved revision while signed out
Requests a sign-in link and confirms it to resume the saved download
Opens a saved download URL that points to a nonexistent revision

flows.name: Maintain saved projects
flows.goal: A returning reviewer can reopen a project, add evidence, inspect its history, or delete and restore it.

steps.action: Opens Brightline client onboarding
Opens Project actions
Clicks Add transcript and enters a follow-up interview
Clicks Save transcript
Opens the Revision menu
Selects Revision 2

branches.action: Clicks Return to latest
Clicks Delete project
Confirms Delete project
Uses Restore within the seven-day window
Opens the restored project
Clicks Sign out

flows.name: Continue modeling in built-in chat
flows.goal: A reviewer can start a conversation, return to a saved reply, and reopen the diagram it updated.

steps.action: Sends process notes or a design change and opens the saved conversation after the reply
Clicks Open diagram and opens the Finance subprocess

branches.action: Clicks New conversation to start over
Clicks Connect your agent to use Claude or ChatGPT instead

flows.name: Upgrade to Pro and manage billing
flows.goal: A reviewer compares plans, starts an upgrade, and checks the payment status and AI allowance.

steps.action: Clicks Choose Pro while signed out
Requests an email link and confirms sign-in to continue to billing
Clicks Choose Pro and returns from checkout
Returns to Billing after payment is confirmed

branches.action: Clicks Billing in the signed-in header
Signs in on an instance that does not offer payments
Clicks Choose Pro when checkout cannot start
Returns to Billing after a renewal payment fails
Clicks Usage and subscription terms
